fresh_external_reference_check.confirmed_rule: A full-length commit SHA is the immutable action pinning form; the selected SHA should be verified as belonging to the intended action repository rather than a fork.

Attestations are cryptographically signed provenance claims and only provide security value when verified; build provenance generation uses scoped permissions including contents:read, id-token:write and attestations:write.
Protected environments can require reviewers and can prevent self-review; approval is an enforced deployment control, not a truthy name field.
Dependency review is computed from dependency changes in pull requests and its check can enforce policy/block merging; a learner-supplied boolean is not equivalent evidence.
Provenance is verifiable information describing where, when and how an artifact was produced.

adversarial_regression_set_revalidated: Malformed prefix-only digests such as sha256:x must not count as artifact identity.
One unpinned action anywhere must fail an all-actions pin gate even if a later action is pinned.
Equal garbage strings for artifact/SBOM/provenance must not prove provenance.
Negative canary rates/times must be rejected as invalid input.
Release-note headings with empty bodies must not be considered operable.
A healthy pipeline run must not be classified as a silent critical failure.
Learner-editable booleans must never be sufficient to produce You Do READY.
Every declared S44 figure id must resolve through the figure registry.
S44 Theory must not render CLIP/Whisper content through the legacy multimodal id.
